status: Reference candidate for user review; not an approved replacement model.
generation_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single clean front-facing male soldier A-pose reference for subsequent Tripo 3D model generation, matching the user's approved visual reference.
Input image 1 is a DESIGN AND STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. It shows two soldiers. Re-create ONLY THE LEFT-HAND SOLDIER as one standalone full-body character, with the left soldier's proportions, clothing and simple face. Do not use the current game mesh as a reference.

Composition: one soldier, perfectly straight-on orthographic front view, centered, fully visible from helmet top to boot soles with generous uncropped margin. Head, nose/chin direction, sternum, hips and feet face directly toward the camera. Neutral symmetric A-pose: both arms straight and relaxed at 45 degrees below horizontal, held clear of the torso. Empty black-gloved hands, relaxed open fingers with clear thumbs, palms oriented forward. Legs straight, feet planted on the same baseline and spaced about shoulder-width, toes pointing forward. No bent-knee combat stance, no twist, no perspective or three-quarter view.

Design: adult male with a broad substantial chest and shoulders, solid thick forearms and upper arms, sturdy legs, strong simple square angular jaw. Faithfully retain the LEFT soldier's heavy muted slate-blue knee-length military coat, large light blue-gray upturned lapels/collar, dark neck scarf, charcoal angular chest plate and chunky shoulder armour, olive drab webbing straps, wide dark belt and simple olive belt pouches, dark trousers and substantial black calf-high boots. A readable front split in the coat exposes both separate legs. Retain the LEFT soldier's angular brimmed blue helmet with its one ivory vertical stripe, and its small simple white four-diamond shoulder insignia. Minimal face: simple warm tan planar face and two small narrow ivory eye shapes under the helmet brim; no detailed iris, eyelashes or realistic skin. Overall adult proportions and heavy jacket silhouette match the LEFT reference figure, not a slim female body enlarged.

Style/materials: convincingly low-polygon stylized game model reference. Large visible flat facets on helmet, face, sleeves, armour, coat, trousers and boots; deliberately economical geometry. Matte solid colour blocks, muted blue-gray as in the reference, not saturated royal/cobalt blue. No fabric weave, grain, scratches, stitch detail, realistic skin, glossy metal or smooth rounded high-poly surfaces. Preserve the appealing restrained colours and strong silhouettes of the supplied concept.

Remove all weapons and all equipment specific to the RIGHT reference soldier: no goggles, no backpack or shoulder-mounted pack, no radio, antenna, arcane crystal apparatus, cables, orange/yellow shoulder patch, circular arcane shoulder glyph, or fingerless gloves. Keep only the base uniform, armour, ordinary webbing and belt pouches described above.
Background: plain uniform light warm gray, no scenery, no props, no pedestal or floor shadows. Soft even neutral studio illumination, readable clean silhouette, no dramatic shadows or baked rim-lighting. No text, labels, diagrams, extra characters, alternate views or watermark. Produce one high-resolution portrait-oriented reference image.
cleanup_prompt: Precise cleanup of this single A-pose male soldier reference. Keep the entire existing character, pose, proportions, helmet, simple eyes and face, chest plate, shoulder armour, blue-gray coat, scarf, olive straps and belt pouches, gloves, boots, framing, colours and flat low-poly style unchanged. Remove ONLY the two dark raised pack-like blocks visible behind the tops of the shoulders, immediately outside the tall blue collar, and any hint of a backpack behind the neck. There must be no backpack, bedroll or equipment protruding behind either shoulder. Restore a natural clean coat/shoulder silhouette underneath, with the ordinary front webbing straps retained. Keep the background plain light warm gray. Do not add any new details or accessories. Single full-body front A-pose; empty hands; no weapon, goggles, antenna or arcane apparatus.
